description: Air pressure of the met forcing in the SFLOW semi-implicit oblique tide (sflow_2d_si_tide_oblique, Riemann edges in, Flather edges out): met file with a Gaussian low (10 hPa, R 800 m) moving at (0.3, 0.2) m/s on a background gradient (0.05, -0.03) Pa/m, no wind (tools/met_forcing.py low); air pressure gradient (W 208 1) and inverse barometer on the four open edges (W 210 1), ramp 600 s.
covers: iowave::eta_ib on Riemann and Flather edges
